summary: Iteration 10 tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 tests pass in test_iteration10.py covering POST /api/recipes with categories (persists as array) and default empty list, PATCH /api/recipes/{id} categories, GET /api/recipes?category= filtering (single + combined with tier, empty when no match), GET /api/branding/etsy-url public no-auth, PUT /api/admin/branding/etsy-url (admin sets and clears, family gets 403), plus regression on /api/, /api/recipes/samples, /api/recipes, /api/printables, /api/recipes/featured, /api/admin/codes, /api/flags. Frontend: verified Admin > Branding > Etsy Shop URL section (etsy-url-input + etsy-url-save present, save triggers toast, GET reflects value); Admin > Recipes shows 6 category chips (admin-recipe-cat-Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner/Snack/Dessert/Holiday) with correct btn-primary toggle behaviour; published test recipe with two categories persists via API; edit form pre-fills selected chips; Library page has full category filter row (library-cat-all + 6 chips), selecting Breakfast triggers API call with ?category=Breakfast and filters visible recipes, category badges render on recipe cards; Gift page /gift 'Buy on Etsy' data-testid=gift-etsy-link href matches admin-set custom URL, falls back to https://www.etsy.com/ after URL cleared. Cleanup performed: Etsy URL cleared to '', test recipe deleted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L523 dead code `pdf.cell(...) if False else None` still present (carried over from iter8/9 — cosmetic).

Category filter server-side uses exact array match {categories: category} which relies on Mongo's array-contains semantics — works correctly, but no case-insensitive support (frontend chips are fixed set so fine).
Frontend Library filter block: 'Category' filter row is placed below tier row without a wrapping fieldset/label for a11y; consider adding aria-label for the whole row.

Etsy URL: no URL format validation server-side (any 500-char string accepted). Frontend uses type='url' which browsers hint at but do not enforce on submit. Acceptable but could add basic https:// validation.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_ITER10 recipes created and all deleted at test end. Etsy URL was set to https://www.etsy.com/shop/JeanaMariesTest during test then cleared back to '' in cleanup step. No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration10.py can be reused for regression. Category chip testids use exact-case category name: admin-recipe-cat-{Category}, library-cat-{Category}, library-cat-all for 'Any'. Etsy endpoints: GET /api/branding/etsy-url (public), PUT /api/admin/branding/etsy-url (admin, {url: ...}). Both stored under settings key 'etsy_url'. Empty string is valid to clear.
